messages:
Ethan B.: Quick heads-up: rolling out G100x-lite dedicated pools in Nairobi (NBO) and Toronto (YYZ) as a targeted preview. :earth_africa: :canada:
Nadia R.: This is a lower-power variant of our G100x family optimized for inference throughput at shorter sequences. Great fit for low-latency embedding workloads and small-batch chat.
Theo M.: Important policy change: these pools will participate in a new nightly rotation window (local midnight-02:00) where we apply fair-share reclaiming to rebalance long-idle reservations.
Signe P.: To be explicit: rotation window does NOT preempt active jobs. It only redistributes truly idle GPUs (idle > rotation_idle_threshold). Well expose rotation_idle_threshold as a per-reservation field.
Ethan B.: Canary plan: small micro-pools (3x8 and 1x16) in NBO starting 2025-07-07; YYZ will follow on 2025-07-09. Canary lasts 7 days, then broader preview if metrics look good.
ops-bot: Canary automation created: attach_g100x-lite -> enable_rotation -> monitor_idle -> collect_util.
Nadia R.: Metrics to watch: reservations.g100x_lite.util, reservations.rotation.reclaimed, reservations.idle.duration. Target uplift: ~6-10% utilization in windowed zones.
Theo M.: Reclaim semantics: owners get a rotation_notice webhook + console ping. If owner denies reclaim within reclaim_ack_window (default 60s) the slot remains with owner for 24h grace.
finance-bot: Billing: reserved customers keep their monthly commitment; any reclaimed time billed to ephemeral consumers at a discounted rate. No retro bills for reclaimed minutes during preview.
Signe P.: Ops checklist for teams: test webhook handlers, validate graceful shutdown on 90s notice, and add teams to preview list if you want early access.
Ethan B.: Customer comms: we will email affected reservation owners 72h before canary and again before preview. Default for new G100x-lite reservations: rotation_enabled=true. Existing reservations opt-in via Console/API.
Nadia R.: Action items:
- Theo: finalize API names (rotation_enabled, rotation_idle_threshold, reclaim_ack_window) by 2025-06-28
- Signe: build rotation UI and webhook docs
- Finance: publish ephemeral pricing draft
- Ops: recruit canary testers and schedule load tests
Ethan B.: Thanks all  drop questions here or DM me for early access. :thumbsup:
